battle.name: 柬越戰爭
battle.theater: 柬埔寨東部與越南邊境
battle.brief: 柬越戰爭於1975年5月在柬埔寨與越南之間展開，是民主柬埔寨方面與社會主義越南之間的持續軍事衝突。Gatling gun（加特林機槍）自1860年起列裝，是旋轉式地面火器，可在陸軍體系中提供多管齊射的高射速與持續火力。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍屬美國陸軍的旋轉式地面火器，配置於部隊與陣地火力支援，透過多管同時發射提供持續性火力。

countries: 1975年的決戰由三股直接作戰力量與數條外部支援線構成。高棉赤色，即以柬埔寨人民革命黨為核心的民主柬埔寨武裝，對上由軍人政變建立、受美國援助的高棉王國政府及其自由高棉武裝部隊；北越人民軍第三軍區等部隊在南柬邊境協同赤色作戰，但始終保有自己的指揮鏈。美國以武器、彈藥、航空顧問與情報支援王國政府，中國及北朝鮮向赤色提供武器、訓練和後勤；泰國提供邊境通道與空運條件，老撾境內的胡志明小道則把北越裝備送入柬南。這是柬埔寨內戰的最後決戰，與1978年才全面爆發的柬越戰爭不是同一場戰爭。
countriesEn: The 1975 campaign involved three direct combat forces and several external support lines. The Khmer Rouge, operating through the core of the Khmer People's Revolutionary Party as the armed forces of Democratic Kampuchea, faced the military-backed Royal Khmer Government and its Free Khmer Armed Forces, which received American support. North Vietnamese forces in the Third Military Region and other formations cooperated with the Khmer Rouge along the southern Cambodian frontier, but retained their own chain of command. The United States supplied the royal government with weapons, ammunition, aviation advisers, and intelligence; China and North Korea provided the Khmer Rouge with weapons, training, and logistics. Thailand provided border access and airlift facilities, while the Ho Chi Minh Trail through Laos carried North Vietnamese equipment into southern Cambodia. This was the final decisive campaign of the Cambodian civil war, not the same conflict as the Cambodian–Vietnamese War that began in full in 1978.
people: 高棉王國一邊由總統儂努爾主持政府，軍方元老涅溫掌握國家權力核心，外交部長兼總理隆博烈是政府與赤色談判的主要代表；被廢黜的施瓦努克則在赤色安排下於1975年6月返國，成為新政府的名義領袖。赤色一邊，波布掌握柬埔寨人民革命黨中央權力，塔莫是武裝最高指揮層的重要元帥，萬納斯參與軍務與後勤調度，宋諾乍率領的高棉人民民族解放武裝力量在末期與赤色合作。北越方面由人民軍總參謀長文進勇及第三、第七軍區指揮部主導南部配合，不能把北越部隊簡化成赤色的一個普通師。作戰過程顯示，波布掌握政治與總體戰略方向，地方赤色指揮官及北越各軍區卻各自決定許多實際突擊與補給安排。
peopleEn: On the Royal Cambodian side, President Lon Nol headed the government, senior military leader Ne Win controlled the core of state power, and Foreign Minister and Prime Minister Long Boret served as the principal government negotiator with the Khmer Rouge. The deposed Sihanouk returned to Cambodia under a Khmer Rouge arrangement in June 1975 and became the nominal leader of the new government. On the Khmer Rouge side, Pol Pot held authority over the central machinery of the Khmer People's Revolutionary Party, Ta Mok was a marshal within the armed forces' highest command, Vann Nath participated in military and logistical coordination, and Son Ngoc Thanh's Khmer People's National Liberation Armed Forces cooperated with the Khmer Rouge during the final phase. For North Vietnam, operations in the south were directed through the army's chief of staff, Văn Tiếu Dũng, and the Third and Seventh Military Region commands; North Vietnamese formations were not simply an ordinary division of the Khmer Rouge. The course of the fighting showed that Pol Pot determined political policy and grand strategy, while local Khmer Rouge commanders and the separate North Vietnamese regional commands retained authority over many actual attacks and logistical decisions.
cause: 衝突根源可追溯至1967年後柬埔寨東部邊境反覆發生的交火。北越與越共在柬埔寨境內取得補給通道和庇護，施瓦努克政府曾嘗試限制其活動，美國與南越的情報行動和邊境打擊則使爭端擴大。1970年3月13日施瓦努克在國外時被推翻，儂努爾隨後要求美國攻擊北越庇護區；美軍自3月20日起執行「菜單行動」，空襲與秘密支援把有限邊界戰變成長期直接介入。1973年1月30日《巴黎和平協定》簽署，同年8月中旬美軍停止轟炸，但福特政府仍繼續援助王國政府，赤色則利用中國、北朝鮮供應及繳獲裝備，把原本分散的游擊隊整編為能持續作戰的步兵師、旅和營。1975年的直接成因，是赤色在乾燥季節奪取省道與城鎮，切斷王國軍的地面補給；北越同時由南側施壓，使首都外圍各師逐漸失去相互支援的可能。
causeEn: The roots of the conflict can be traced to recurrent clashes along Cambodia's eastern frontier after 1967. North Vietnamese and Viet Cong forces obtained supply routes and sanctuary inside Cambodia. The Sihanouk government attempted to restrict those activities, while American and South Vietnamese intelligence operations and border strikes widened the dispute. On 13 March 1970, Sihanouk was overthrown while abroad, and Lon Nol subsequently asked the United States to strike the North Vietnamese sanctuary areas. American bombing under Operation Menu began on 20 March, transforming a limited frontier conflict into a prolonged direct intervention. The Paris Peace Accords were signed on 30 January 1973, and American bombing ceased in mid-August, but the Ford administration continued aid to the royal government. Meanwhile, Chinese and North Korean supplies, together with captured equipment, allowed the Khmer Rouge to reorganize dispersed guerrillas into infantry divisions, regiments, and battalions capable of sustained operations. The immediate cause of the 1975 campaign was the Khmer Rouge's dry-season seizure of provincial roads and towns, cutting the government's ground supply lines while North Vietnamese pressure from the south isolated the divisions around the capital.
kits: 裝備應以1975年以前已列裝的型號核對，而不能把後來才出現或無法證實的戰利品算作制式配備。赤色步兵大量使用AK-47與AKM、中國56式衝鋒槍、SKS半自動步槍、RPG-7火箭筒及B-10 82毫米無後坐力砲；北越軍另有PKM 7.62毫米通用機槍、NSV或DShK 12.7毫米重機槍、M120 120毫米迫擊砲與PT-76輕戰車。王國軍可用M16A1步槍、M4卡賓槍、FN FAL步槍、M2重機槍、M60通用機槍、M24狙擊槍，以及M2A1 105毫米和M114系列155毫米榴彈砲；赤色在戰場上也使用從王國軍繳獲的混合口徑武器與砲。高棉空軍曾配屬A-1「空中戰士」攻擊機、T-28「特洛伊」機、T-41教練／對地攻擊機及C-47運輸機。上述武器對應的主要彈藥包括7.62×39、7.62×51、7.62×54R、5.56×45、.30-06與12.7×39毫米步機槍彈，以及82毫米、120毫米迫擊砲彈和105、122、155毫米榴彈砲彈；這些裝備全部早於或至遲在1975年已存在。
kitsEn: Equipment should be checked against models fielded before 1975; later weapons and unverified trophies should not be presented as standard issue. Khmer Rouge infantry extensively used the AK-47 and AKM, the Chinese Type 56 submachine gun, the SKS semiautomatic rifle, the RPG-7, and the B-10 82 mm recoilless rifle. North Vietnamese forces also had the PKM 7.62 mm general-purpose machine gun, NSV or DShK 12.7 mm heavy machine guns, the M120 120 mm mortar, and PT-76 light tanks. Royal government forces could field the M16A1, M4 carbine, FN FAL, M2 heavy machine gun, M60 general-purpose machine gun, M24 sniper rifle, and the M2A1 105 mm and M114-series 155 mm howitzers. The Khmer Rouge also employed mixed-caliber weapons and artillery captured from royal government units in combat. The Royal Khmer Air Force had previously been assigned the A-1 Skyraider attack aircraft, T-28 Trojan, T-41 trainer and counterinsurgency aircraft, and C-47 transports. The corresponding principal ammunition included 7.62×39, 7.62×51, 7.62×54R, 5.56×45, .30-06, and 12.7×39 mm rifle and machine-gun ammunition, as well as 82 mm and 120 mm mortar rounds and 105, 122, and 155 mm howitzer shells. Every model listed already existed by 1975.
tactics: 赤色在1974年10月下旬奪取Chhom Ksan，切斷第4號國道；同年12月控制塔基奧一帶後，3號與6號國道的外線也受威脅。1975年1月至2月，巴里文、貢布與斯維里仁等外圍據點相繼失守或遭到隔離，主要壓力沿西北的3號、6號國道，東側的2號國道，以及由斯維里仁向西北推進的北越走廊收斂。3月14日前後的Neak Lark戰鬥中，赤色以步兵分隊、機槍組、RPG與無後坐力砲隊逐點攻擊公路樞紐，政府軍則利用路障、側翼陣地和榴彈砲封鎖路口。赤色仍以營、旅、師級支隊結合地方游擊支隊作戰，由工兵排雷、架橋、修復道路，補給車隊沿公路邊緣移動；北越部隊的工程、砲兵和後勤單位協助打通南側通道，卻不歸赤色總部直接指揮。圍城後，王國軍把主力縮在首都外圍與市內軍營，空軍只能在有限空域執行偵察和近距支援，地面各師被公路割裂後難以互通彈藥。最後進城階段，赤色著重控制波森當（Pochentong）機場、主要路口與政府通訊節點，再處理零星據點；彈藥消耗集中在7.62毫米步機槍彈及各種迫擊砲、榴彈砲彈藥，燃料不足、車輛維修困難與雨季道路泥濘則限制持續作戰。
tacticsEn: The Khmer Rouge seized Chhom Ksan in late October 1974, cutting National Highway 4. After taking control of the Takeo area in December, they also threatened the outer sections of Highways 3 and 6. From January through February 1975, outlying positions at Prey Veng, Kompong Cham, and Svay Rieng fell or were isolated. The main pressure converged along Highways 3 and 6 in the northwest, Highway 2 to the east, and the North Vietnamese corridor advancing northwest from Svay Rieng. In the fighting around Neak Lark on or about 14 March, Khmer Rouge infantry sections, machine-gun teams, RPG teams, and recoilless-rifle groups attacked highway junctions point by point. Government troops used roadblocks, flank positions, and howitzer fire to block the approaches. The Khmer Rouge nevertheless fought with battalion-, regiment-, and division-level formations combined with local guerrilla branches. Engineer units removed obstacles, bridged waterways, and repaired roads, while supply columns moved along road margins. North Vietnamese engineering, artillery, and logistics formations helped open the southern approaches but did not operate under direct Khmer Rouge command. After the encirclement, government forces concentrated in the capital's outer perimeter and urban garrisons. Their air force could conduct reconnaissance and close support only over a shrinking area, and isolated ground formations could no longer exchange ammunition efficiently. During the final entry into the city, the Khmer Rouge concentrated on Pochentong airfield, major intersections, and government communications nodes before dealing with isolated strongpoints. Ammunition expenditure centered on 7.62 mm rifle and machine-gun ammunition and mortar and howitzer shells, while fuel shortages, vehicle maintenance problems, and muddy roads during the wet season restricted sustained operations.
data: 可核對的時間線如下：1967年後，柬埔寨東部邊境戰鬥擴大；1970年3月13日軍人推翻施瓦努克，3月20日美軍開始「菜單行動」；1973年1月30日《巴黎和平協定》簽署，8月中旬美軍停止轟炸，但援助延續；1974年10月下旬赤色奪取Chhom Ksan，12月控制塔基奧；1975年1月至2月，巴里文、貢布與斯維里仁方向相繼易手，3月14日前後發生Neak Lark戰鬥；4月1日美方啟動撤離應變，先撤出非作戰外交與後勤人員，軍事及使館核心單位留待後撤；4月17日赤色先頭部隊開始進入首都，此日代表控制權開始轉移，並不表示全部市區當日清空；4月29日至30日「疾風行動」撤走南越的美國軍事人員，4月30日駐金邊使館與守衛亦由海軍艦艇和直升機完成最後撤離；5月初市區零星抵抗基本結束；6月7日施瓦努克返抵金邊；9月7日新憲制公布，施瓦努克成為民主柬埔寨的國君，實權由赤色掌握。各方對1975年最後階段傷亡的統計口徑不一，本文因此不列無法交叉核驗的精確總數。
dataEn: The verifiable timeline is as follows: fighting along Cambodia's eastern frontier expanded after 1967; military officers overthrew Sihanouk on 13 March 1970, and Operation Menu began on 20 March; the Paris Peace Accords were signed on 30 January 1973, bombing ceased in mid-August, but aid continued; the Khmer Rouge seized Chhom Ksan in late October 1974 and controlled Takeo in December; during January and February 1975, Prey Veng, Kompong Cham, and the Svay Rieng area changed hands in succession, followed by the fighting around Neak Lark on or about 14 March; on 1 April the United States began its evacuation response, first removing noncombat diplomatic and logistics personnel while retaining combat and core embassy units for later departure; on 17 April Khmer Rouge vanguard forces began entering the capital, marking the transfer of control rather than the instantaneous clearing of every urban position; during 29–30 April Operation Frequent Wind removed remaining American military personnel from South Vietnam, and on 30 April the Phnom Penh embassy and its guards completed their final withdrawal by naval vessels and helicopters; isolated urban resistance largely ended in early May; Sihanouk arrived in Phnom Penh on 7 June; and on 7 September a new constitution established Sihanouk as monarch of Democratic Kampuchea, with real authority held by the Khmer Rouge. The belligerents used incompatible definitions for casualties during the final phase of 1975, so no precise totals that could not be cross-verified are given here.
impact: 軍事上，自由高棉武裝部隊並非全數在戰場上被消滅，而是隨公路割裂、補給中斷與指揮中樞崩潰而瓦解；部分單位向泰國邊境撤退，其餘則投降或被俘。王國軍留下的槍砲、卡車、無線電、維修工場、燃料與機場因此轉入赤色手中，赤色也由游擊隊進一步轉型為控制固定據點與國防線的國家軍隊。外交上，美國使館撤離使金邊原有的援助與軍事合作網中斷，王國政府的國際生存能力隨之消失。赤色與北越的合作卻沒有形成統一指揮：赤色取得中央政治權力，北越人民軍仍保留自己的軍區、營區與補給系統，兩者的界線逐步移到越柬邊境。1975年後邊境已有零星衝突，但全面國家間戰爭到1978年才爆發，因此1975年的結果同時是金邊政權的更替，也是後續邊界戰爭的起點。
impactEn: militarily, the Free Khmer Armed Forces were not annihilated on the battlefield; they disintegrated as roads were cut, supply was interrupted, and the central command system collapsed. Some formations withdrew toward the Thai frontier, while others surrendered or were captured. The royal army's guns, trucks, radios, maintenance workshops, fuel, and airfields consequently passed to the Khmer Rouge, which also evolved from guerrilla forces into a national army capable of holding fixed installations and national defenses. Diplomatically, the withdrawal of the American embassy broke Phnom Penh's established aid and military-cooperation network, eliminating the royal government's immediate international means of support. Cooperation between the Khmer Rouge and North Vietnam did not produce a unified command: the Khmer Rouge obtained central political power, while PAVN retained its own military regions, units, and logistical system, and the boundary between them gradually shifted toward the Vietnamese-Cambodian frontier. Limited border clashes followed during 1975, but a full interstate war did not begin until 1978. The 1975 outcome was therefore both a change of government in Phnom Penh and the starting point of the later border war.
result: 若以戰役判準衡量，赤色在北越配合下取得1975年決戰的勝利，而自由高棉武裝部隊作為有效軍事力量則告瓦解。4月17日赤色先頭部隊開始進入首都，月底前殘餘據點的抵抗基本停止；此後赤色控制中央政府與主要省道，施瓦努克於6月返國，9月新憲制成立，民主柬埔寨的名稱、軍隊與對外機構均由赤色主導。儂努爾、隆博烈及多名高層在城破前後離境，留在金邊的機構沒有形成可運作的替代軍政府。這個結果終結了柬埔寨內戰在中央政權層面的主要鬥爭，卻沒有解決赤色與北越共同控制邊境地帶的問題；越柬邊界戰役持續，1978年12月更發展成全面柬越戰爭。因此，1975年的明確成果是赤色奪取金邊與國家權力，而不是所有邊境戰鬥當時已經結束。
resultEn: By battlefield criteria, the Khmer Rouge won the 1975 campaign with North Vietnamese assistance, and the Free Khmer Armed Forces ceased to function as an effective military force. Khmer Rouge vanguards began entering the capital on 17 April, and resistance at the remaining positions largely ended before the end of the month. The Khmer Rouge subsequently controlled the central government and the main provincial highways; Sihanouk returned in June, and a new constitution in September established Democratic Kampuchea's name, army, and external institutions under Khmer Rouge direction. Lon Nol, Long Boret, and other senior leaders departed Cambodia around the fall of the capital, while the institutions remaining in Phnom Penh did not produce a functioning alternative military government. This result ended the principal contest for Cambodia's central authority, but it did not resolve the border zone jointly held by the Khmer Rouge and North Vietnam. Fighting along the Vietnamese-Cambodian frontier continued and expanded into the full Cambodian–Vietnamese War in December 1978. The clear outcome of 1975 was therefore the Khmer Rouge's seizure of Phnom Penh and state power, not the immediate end of all border warfare.
